Exact row quoted: "2026-02-28 | ACUTE ENGITECH | TO THE ORDER OF | Gauge Parts Accessories; Port Component Used For Measuring/Controlling Pressure, Made Of Stainless Steel, Machined | A- SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India | Sandiego, UNITED STATES | 90269000 | 1107692". Further dated rows seen: 2026-02-26 Houston Intercontin, UNITED STATES, HS 90269000, BOL 1051532; 2026-02-18 Houston Intercontin, UNITED STATES, HS 90269000, BOL 9766641; 2026-02-17 London Heathrow, UNITED KINGDOM, HS 90269000, BOL 9761820; 2026-02-12 NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1 -> Bangkok, THAILAND, HS 90269000, BOL 9608627. Source counter: page claims 590 total shipments; 5 individual dated rows actually visible on the free view (rest paywalled).
note: Actual export shipments are confirmed by dated Indian customs records with destination, HS code and B/L number — this is fact, not a website claim. Declared HS 730640 (tubes/pipes of stainless steel, welded) does NOT match the observed shipments: every visible record is HS 90269000 (parts/accessories for instruments for measuring or controlling pressure — gauge parts, valve/accessory for gauge, stainless steel machined components). Per project rules this is not a rejection ground: company stays in the base, actual HS should be corrected to 90269000, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. The claimed industry 'IT и электроника' is also inaccurate — the goods are machined stainless-steel instrument/gauge components (engineering, not IT/electronics). Address fragment visible in the supplier table: 'UNIT NO- A/11, APEX INDUSTRIAL COMP., B/H TOYOTA SHOWROOM' (consistent with a Pune-area industrial estate; state not independently confirmed). Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: web_search backend returned 'Connection refused' on both attempts, zaubacorp.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, and no public tender/contract record was seen — so domestic_status is unknown, not 'none_found'. Revenue and export volume figures are not public on the free views: null, not estimated. No PAN/CIN found in accessible sources: null.
